articles.title: FCC aprueba despliegue de 1 millón de satélites IA de SpaceX
articles.raw_content:
In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full "constellation" of AI satellites.

The FCC's approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX's request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space "graveyard" orbits, rather than …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: FCC autoriza a SpaceX a desplegar hasta 1 millón de satélites equipados con chips IA bajo la iniciativa Starmind. Es la primera aprobación de una constelación completa de satélites IA. Se exige al menos un lanzamiento antes de 2033 y alcanzar el millón para 2040. La agencia pospone la eliminación de satélites sobre 600 km.

articles.title: Nvidia pospone centros de IA, presión sobre neoclouds
articles.raw_content: ⁠Nvidia has made clear⁠ it won’t backstop an AI data center until it’s nearly ready to run, and that’s landing just as neoclouds report construction delays and more expensive debt. The message to developers is that land, power, and a finished building matter more than a pitch deck.  ⁠Anita Verma-Lallian⁠ has been selling exactly that. […]
articles.summary: Nvidia ha dejado claro que no financiará centros de datos de IA hasta que estén casi operativos, lo que coincide con retrasos en la construcción y deudas más caras para las neoclouds. El mensaje es que la tierra, la energía y la infraestructura terminada superan a la presentación de un pitch deck. Anita Verma‑Lallian vende esa solución.

articles.title: Estudio revela rápido crecimiento del Wi‑Fi 6 GHz, pero España queda rezagada
articles.raw_content: New research points to accelerating 6GHz Wi-Fi adoption in the US, with compatible devices and networks driving significant usage gains. Europe lags amid restricted spectrum availability and uneven broadband equipment…
articles.summary: Un nuevo estudio muestra que la adopción del Wi‑Fi 6 GHz crece rápidamente en EE. UU., impulsada por dispositivos y redes compatibles. En Europa, la disponibilidad limitada de espectro y la desigualdad en equipos de banda ancha retrasan la expansión, lo que afecta a España y a los operadores europeos.

articles.title: eRedCap y eSIM impulsan IoT legado hacia operaciones listas para IA
articles.raw_content: eRedCap, eSIM and layered security: matching connectivity to each application In sum – what to know: The IoT market is entering another transition as new connectivity options meet growing interest…
articles.summary: La combinación de eRedCap, eSIM y seguridad en capas permite adaptar la conectividad a cada aplicación, acelerando la transición del IoT tradicional a entornos preparados para la inteligencia artificial. La adopción de nuevas opciones de conectividad responde a la creciente demanda de soluciones más inteligentes y seguras en el mercado de IoT.

articles.title: Amazon acelera lanzamientos con SpaceX tras fallo de ULA
articles.raw_content:
A European Ariane 6 launcher propelled 36 satellites into orbit for the Amazon Leo broadband constellation Tuesday, continuing the network's build-out after 40 satellites were lost earlier this month during a failure of United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket.

The launch was an important rebound for Amazon, bringing the Amazon Leo fleet to 432 satellites as the company seeks to fill the void left by the grounding of ULA's Vulcan rocket, Amazon's primary launch provider. Now, an Amazon official tells Ars it is accelerating several Falcon 9 launches the company has purchased from SpaceX, which also owns the Starlink satellite network that Amazon seeks to dethrone.

The next Falcon 9 launch for Amazon Leo is now planned for December, Amazon said, moved forward from its previous launch date next year. Several more Falcon 9s are scheduled to launch Amazon Leo satellites in rapid succession after the December flight.

articles.summary: Amazon ha impulsado su constelación Leo con un lanzamiento de Ariane 6, añadiendo 36 satélites tras la pérdida de 40 en el fallo del cohete Vulcan de ULA. El impulso europeo refuerza la posición de Amazon en el mercado de telecomunicaciones, mientras acelera lanzamientos Falcon 9 de SpaceX para cubrir la brecha. Esta estrategia es clave para el sector europeo

articles.title: Fincher acusado de usar IA en su nueva película
articles.raw_content:
Though David Fincher's fans had been eagerly anticipating The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, early screenings of the Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film. People have claimed that the movie is chock-full of uncanny, inconsistent visuals that make it feel more like slop than the sort of polished film you'd expect from the director of sleek productions like Fight Club and The Social Network.

Following a number of Cliff Booth critics screenings that took place last week ahead of the film's premiere on November 25th, moviegoers rushed to social med …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: Fans de David Fincher se han quejado de que su nueva película, 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth', parece haber usado IA generativa, según críticas de primeras proyecciones. Los espectadores señalaron imágenes extrañas e inconsistentes que no reflejan la calidad típica del director. La polémica sigue sin confirmarse oficialmente.

articles.raw_content: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.
articles.summary: El ex CEO de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, será testigo en una audiencia del Senado la próxima semana, tras su reinstalación. La audiencia responde a llamadas bipartidistas para que explique su relación con un presunto espía chino.

articles.title: Jensen Huang vuelve a ser CEO y presidente de Nvidia
articles.raw_content:
Nvidia's board of directors has voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman of the board, just 11 days after he resigned in the wake of multiple scandals.

The reinstatement, announced Monday morning, is "effective immediately" and was based in part on "input from senior levels of the United States government" that assured the board members that "Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk."

That assurance comes despite Huang's admitted affair with a woman who, US intelligence sources believe, was working as a Chinese spy and allegations that Nvidia had subverted export controls meant to keep Nvidia chips from reaching China. It also comes despite multiple developing investigations from multiple different government departments into those and other alleged national security, accounting, and corporate governance failures.

Read full article

Comments
articles.summary: El consejo de Nvidia ha decidido reinstaurar a Jensen Huang como CEO y presidente del consejo, tras su renuncia de hace 11 días. La decisión se basa en garantías de que su retorno no representa riesgo de seguridad nacional, pese a escándalos de relaciones personales y supuestas violaciones de controles de exportación.

articles.title: Crecimiento del RAN al máximo en cinco años, pero perspectivas de 5G se mantienen
articles.raw_content: From the newsletter (November 20; sign-up or follow if you want it sooner): Dell’Oro reports a fragile 5G recovery, with RAN growth at a five-year high but spending outlooks broadly…
articles.summary: Dell’Oro indica que el crecimiento del RAN alcanza su nivel más alto en cinco años, aunque las previsiones de gasto en 5G se mantienen planas. La recuperación del sector 5G sigue siendo frágil, con inversiones que no superan los niveles previos a la pandemia. Los operadores deben gestionar expectativas y optimizar despliegues.
